name: Cockroach swarm (name pending)
name_status: Descriptive placeholder; Storyboarding candidates awaiting Sean selection
description: A floor swarm of constantly skittering cockroaches assembles into a giant rat, collapses after damage, and reforms as a giant alligator. Individual insects continue crawling while each animal silhouette holds.
implementation_status: Commissioned concept and sprite source artwork; not implemented. Alpha cleanup, frame registration, loop and transition continuity remain pending.

bar.name: Use selected name when approved; no invented final name

health.model: One shared continuous pool, no phase refill. Rat atHP>180; first crossing to<=180 schedules transformation exactly once ifHP>0; alligator uses remainingHP.
health.damage_accounting: Apply each hit once with full damage and carry threshold overkill into shared pool. HP0 always wins over queued transformation; death only once. Never reset threshold latch until encounter reset.
health.rationale: 360HP sits above180HP aerial elite and below720HP finale; guideline bands are not hard constraints. Shared pool gives visible progress and avoids secretly doubling health. Exact20–35s encounter target is unvalidated.
health.comparison_limits: ceil(maxHP/damage), full-health no armor, excluding travel/misses/attackwindup and3s transform. Timing is continuous firing ideal, not fight length. Composite insect geometry never multiplies explosion/piercing hits. Melee recovery access must be validated when tools implemented.

runtime_support_note: Schema compatibility only. Planned creature with no gameplay actor or encounter; runtime HP unset.
